# BatteryConfig

> **File:** `config/BatteryConfig.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Reader for the Battery section. Named BatteryConfig because `Battery` is a bar widget and module type.

### Properties

- `notify` (readonly bool): Notify on reaching the low, then the critical level
- `lowThreshold` (readonly int): Percentages at or below which the battery is low / critical
- `criticalThreshold` (readonly int)
